kind: Controlled EditMode full production RaceCanvas. A4 labels and technology states are explicit presentation fixtures; no running match, actual heat transfer, gameplay balance or complete-mode acceptance.
lifecycle: Owned preview scene/canvas/camera, disabled project behaviours and explicitly invoked HUD.Start plus production ApplyLayout. Owned static font/material clones; exact settings current/repository restoration. Before keeps the original disabled A4 driver slot; after calls the production technology widget and ShowTechnologyCardChoice through reflection, with counter callbacks only. No source fonts, scenes, player save or settings persistence.
